guide: Both ideas become active together. Explain what each contributes and which decision depends on the combination.
Neither idea is active. Explore what that absence means for the product. Do not assume the result is a compromise.
The first idea is reinforced by the absence of the second. Show what this emphasis changes in practice.
The second idea is reinforced by the absence of the first. Show what this emphasis changes in practice.
The first idea and its negation are in tension. Treat this as a diagnostic, such as a design rule that undermines the stated principle.
The second idea and its negation are in tension. Treat this as a diagnostic, such as behavior that undoes the intended meaning.
